title: Hierarchical Workload Budgets
summary: Enterprise, tenant, and service budgets are enforced as non-additive constraints.
why: Prevents the need for complex 'pre-allocation' or 'spending' across a tree; instead, any single reservation must fit within every ancestor ceiling atomically.
invariants: A single commitment is reflected at each level for constraint and audit purposes.
Child ceilings are constraints, not pre-spent allocations.
Sibling children may sum beyond the parent ceiling, provided no single reservation violates any ancestor.
evidence_note: Source: oorexx_work_load_units_v0.12/README.md:33-45. Specifically line 37: 'hierarchy figures are NOT additive.'
